blur_classifier.name: YOLOv8n-cls Blur Classifier (4-class)
blur_classifier.notes: Top-1 98.68%. Re-exported 2026-08-14 with dynamic=True: the batch axis is dynamic so classify_batch issues one (N,3,224,224) ONNX call instead of a per-image loop. Ultralytics also makes H/W dynamic; the wrapper always centre-crops and resizes to 224 so that is inert. Verified bit-identical to the previous static export (max abs diff 0.0) and batched-vs-per-image agreement within float32 epsilon. Measured CPU gain is small (~1.06x on 50 images) because the model is tiny and ONNX Runtime already parallelises a single inference — batching is what pays off on GPU. Optional model, loaded only if the .onnx exists. Re-run export_blur_classifier.py to regenerate; it self-verifies the dynamic axis.
